thread:
olga: CI started failing mypy on the python SDK tests after the autogen update. The API has a nullable `metadata` field but generated model uses `Dict[str, Any]` (non-Optional) and mypy flags it when we do `if obj.metadata is None:`.

olga: repro snippet:```python
from mypkg.models import ItemResponse

r = ItemResponse(**payload)
if r.metadata is None:
    # mypy: Incompatible types in expression (actual type: "Dict[str, Any]", expected: "None")
    handle_empty()
```

emma: ugh. CI log? which mypy version? :grimacing:

olga: pasted below (shortened):
```
mypy 0.991
src/mypkg/models.py:42: error: Incompatible types in conditional (expression has type "Dict[str, Any]", variable has type "Optional[Dict[str, Any]]")  [assignment]
```

sam: looks like the generator is emitting `Dict[str, Any]` even when the OpenAPI schema has `nullable: true`. That should map to `Optional[Dict[str, Any]]`. Might be a template bug.

jesse: pyright and mypy differ here sometimes. For generated pydantic models we usually declare `metadata: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None`. Is there an example of the generated model?

olga: here's the relevant bit from `models.py` (auto-gen):```python
class ItemResponse(BaseModel):
    id: str
    metadata: Dict[str, Any] = None
```

olga: note `metadata: Dict[str, Any] = None` is legal at runtime with pydantic but mypy complains because the annotation says non-Optional.

sam: yep. two options: change annotation to `Optional[Dict[str, Any]]` OR change to `Any` plus runtime check. The proper typed fix is Optional.

mike: CI pinned mypy to 0.991 last month (breaking change in 0.990 -> 0.991 around `None` checks). Could be why this surfaced now. But generator should be correct regardless.

jesse: quick workaround in CI: add `# type: ignore[assignment]` inline for that field, but that's ugly at scale. We should fix generator.

sam: I pushed a tiny sketch of a generator template patch in a draft branch:```jinja
{%- if prop.nullable -%}
{{ name }}: Optional[{{ type_hint }}] = None
{%- else -%}
{{ name }}: {{ type_hint }}
{%- endif -%}
```

sam: also added an integration test that loads an OpenAPI fragment with `nullable: true` and checks generated code parses with mypy.

emma: can we also add a pyright check in CI? We have a couple of downstream users on pyright and sometimes the two disagree. :thinking_face:

sam: good idea. I'll add a short pyright job (fast) to the matrix.

olga: for immediate unblocking, can someone cherry-pick the template change into the v0.3.x branch that our SDK release uses? We have an active customer using `metadata` as nullable and it's a blocker.

sam: I can open a PR against v0.3.x after the patch lands on main. Will tag you, @olga, for verification.

jesse: one more nuance: if the schema uses `oneOf`/`anyOf` unions we generate `Union[...]`. mypy sometimes wants `Optional[Union[...]]` when `nullable: true`. Make sure the transform adds `None` into unions, not just wrap with Optional, because `Optional[Union[A, B]]` == `Union[A, B, None]` but template wise it's simpler to produce `Union[A, B, None]` to avoid double Optional.

sam: good catch. I'll add a helper to flatten and dedupe union types and append `None` when nullable.

olga: CI bot posted a quick run after your branch, sam?

ci-bot: quick-mypy-check passed on draft branch (only runs changed tests). Full CI still failing until v0.3.x cherry-pick.

mike: once PR is up let's also bump the SDK generator dependency in the release branch. We should avoid ad-hoc local fixes.

emma: can we add a small note in the SDK README about generated models and mypy quirks? New contributors keep tripping on this.

sam: will add README blurb + changelog entry. Also linking to internal ticket DEVEX-412 for rollout plan.

olga: thanks — if we get the v0.3.x patch this afternoon we can cut a micro release to unblock the customer. :pray: 

sam: filing PR now -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/3421 :eyes:

jesse: reviewed the patch, left 2 tiny comments about import ordering and using `typing.get_args` in the union helper.

olga: marking this thread resolved for me once PR is merged. Thanks all. :tada:
